! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
! Section 1 — EasyList-style network filters
! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
||ads.example.com^
||adserver.example.net^
||tracking.example.org^
||metrics.example.io^
||pixel.example.co.uk^
||example.com/banner/*$image,third-party
||example.com/ads/*.js$script
||cdn.example.com/sponsored-$script,stylesheet
/ads/leaderboard.gif
-advertisement-icon.
&ad_box_
||example.net^*/adframe.
||doubleclick.invalid^$third-party
||partner.example.com^$~third-party
||example.org/track.gif|
|http://ads.example.info/
||example.com/ad?id=$xmlhttprequest
||tracker.example.com^$important
||beacon.example.com^$ping,beacon
||ws.example.com^$websocket
||fonts.example.com/ad.woff$font
||media.example.com/preroll.mp4$media
||other.example.com/thing$other
||frame.example.com^$subdocument
||api.example.com/collect$xhr,method=post
||api.example.com/beacon$method=get|~post
||sub.example.com^$domain=publisher.com|~safe.publisher.com
||entity.example.com^$domain=newspaper.*
||cdn.example.com/lib.js$to=cdn.example.com
||host.example.com^$denyallow=allowed.example.com,domain=site.example
||case.example.com/AdBox$match-case
||regexy.example.com^$document

! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
! Section 2 — regex filters
! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
/^https?:\/\/[a-z]{2,10}\.ad\.example\.com\//
/banner[0-9]{2,4}\.(gif|png)$/$image
/^https?:\/\/(?=evil)\.example\.com\//
/\1backref\.example\.com/

! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
! Section 3 — exceptions
! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
@@||cdn.example.com^$script,domain=site.example
@@||safe.example.com^
@@||whitelisted.example.com^$document
@@||example.com/acceptable-ads.js$script
@@||shop.example.com^$elemhide
@@||news.example.com^$generichide
@@||forum.example.com^$specifichide
@@||nocsp.example.com^$csp

! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
! Section 4 — uBO-specific options
! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
||example.com/ads/gpt.js$script,redirect=noop.js
||example.com/video.mp4$mp4
||example.com/empty.js$empty
||example.com/pixel.gif$image,redirect=1x1.gif
||example.com/analytics.js$script,redirect-rule=noop.js
||example.com/analytics.js$script
$removeparam=utm_source
$removeparam=utm_medium
||shop.example.com^$removeparam=affiliate_id
||csp.example.com^$csp=script-src 'none'
||perm.example.com^$permissions=autoplay=()
||hdr.example.com^$removeheader=refresh
||hdr.example.com^$removeheader=request:cookie
||forbidden.example.com^$removeheader=origin
||type.example.com^$header=content-type:application/json
||notype.example.com^$header=~content-length
||badfiltered.example.com^
||badfiltered.example.com^$badfilter

! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
! Section 5 — unsupported options (must be dropped with a warning)
! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
||popup.example.com^$popup
||popunder.example.com^$popunder
||inline.example.com^$inline-script
||strict.example.com^$strict3p
||replace.example.com^$replace=/a/b/
||webrtc.example.com^$webrtc
||unknown.example.com^$notanoption
||cname.example.com^$cname

! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
! Section 6 — hosts-file lines mixed in
! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
0.0.0.0 hosts-one.example.com
0.0.0.0 hosts-two.example.com
127.0.0.1 hosts-three.example.com
0.0.0.0 localhost
127.0.0.1 broadcasthost
0.0.0.0 hosts-four.example.com # trailing comment

! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
! Section 7 — cosmetic filters
! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
##.ad-banner
##.sponsored-post
###top-ad
example.com##.site-ad
example.com,example.net##.shared-ad
~safe.example.com,example.com##.negated-ad
entity.*##.entity-ad
example.com#@#.site-ad
#@#.ad-banner
example.com#?#.card:has-text(Sponsored)
example.com#?#div.item:-abp-has(> .promo)
example.com##.dim:style(opacity: 0.1 !important)
example.com##.gone:remove()
example.com##^div[ad]

! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
! Section 8 — scriptlets
! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
example.com##+js(set-constant, adConfig, false)
example.com##+js(abort-on-property-read, adBlockDetected)
news.example.com##+js(no-setTimeout-if, /adsbygoogle/, 1000)
example.com#@#+js(set-constant, adConfig, false)

! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
! Section 9 — pre-processor directives
! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
!#if env_chromium
||chromium-only.example.com^
!#else
||firefox-only.example.com^
!#endif
!#if env_firefox
||never.example.com^
!#endif
!#if (env_chromium && !env_firefox)
||nested-ok.example.com^
!#endif
!#include fragments/extra.txt

! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
! Section 10 — duplicates and shadowed rules
! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
||ads.example.com^
||ads.example.com/specific/path.js$script
||dup.example.com^$script
||dup.example.com^$script
! End of list
